name: Audible
description: Audible is an online audiobook and spoken-word entertainment subscription service operated as a subsidiary of Amazon.

stock.note: Reflects parent company Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN); Audible does not have a separate publicly traded stock.

marketing_spend.derivation: Modeled using category-typical digital streaming marketing-to-revenue ratios (12-18%) applied to estimated Audible subscription revenues within Amazon's subscription services segment.

business_updates.headline: Amazon announced Q2 2026 financial results, reporting net sales up 20% year-over-year and operating income reaching $27.5 billion.
